name: print-social-cobalt-grid-step-five-poster-tutorial-slide
title: Cobalt Step Five Tutorial Slide
whatItIs: A saturated blue slide with big glossy italic 'Step 5', a subtitle 'Add some details', a framed poster preview of smiling children with face-selection boxes, sparkle stars and a swipe cue.
whatItMeans: Glossy chrome-like numerals and sparkles feel fun and current, and the preview shows the exact result of the step.
techniques: Chrome gradient on the step title
Faint grid and four-point sparkle stars
Preview of the work in progress at centre
Selection boxes drawn on the preview to teach where to act
Swipe prompt and author handle in the footer

vocabulary.definition: Lettering with a metallic gradient highlight.
A four-point star used as a decorative accent.
A small indicator prompting the next carousel slide.
